title: RAG System
summary: The RAG System module provides tools and configurations for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), enabling integration with various vector databases like ChromaDB and Qdrant for efficient document retrieval and embedding.

nodes.label: RAG Module Wrapper
nodes.title: RAG Module Wrapper
nodes.description: Intercepts attribute setting for RAG configuration, ensuring proper initialization and preventing unauthorized modifications.

nodes.label: RAG Client Factory
nodes.title: RAG Client Factory
nodes.description: Dynamically creates RAG client instances based on the provided configuration, supporting different vector database providers.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Configuration
nodes.title: ChromaDB Configuration
nodes.description: Defines default settings for ChromaDB, including persistence directory and reset options, to ensure consistent behavior.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Client Creation
nodes.title: ChromaDB Client Creation
nodes.description: Handles the creation of a ChromaDB client instance, managing persistence and settings based on the provided configuration.

nodes.label: Qdrant Configuration
nodes.title: Qdrant Configuration
nodes.description: Provides default options for Qdrant client parameters, primarily focusing on file-based storage for vector data.

nodes.label: Qdrant Types
nodes.title: Qdrant Types
nodes.description: Defines Pydantic models for Qdrant-specific parameters, such as embedding function wrappers and collection creation parameters, ensuring type safety.

nodes.label: Base Client Parameters
nodes.title: Base Client Parameters
nodes.description: Abstract base classes for defining parameters used in adding documents to and searching within RAG collections.

nodes.label: Embedding Function Protocol
nodes.title: Embedding Function Protocol
nodes.description: Defines a protocol for functions that convert input data into vector embeddings, including validation and normalization of outputs.

nodes.label: Tool Adapters
nodes.title: Tool Adapters
nodes.description: Provides interfaces for integrating various external tools and services, including RAG systems, into the CrewAI framework.

groups.label: RAG Core
groups.title: RAG Core Logic
groups.description: Central components for managing RAG configurations, client creation, and embedding functions.

groups.label: ChromaDB Integration
groups.title: ChromaDB Integration
groups.description: Components specific to configuring and interacting with ChromaDB as a vector store.

groups.label: Qdrant Integration
groups.title: Qdrant Integration
groups.description: Components specific to configuring and interacting with Qdrant as a vector store.
